name: NexusForge AI
description_es: Plataforma de orquestación multi-agente con 22 agentes, 6 topologías de enjambre, memoria de 3 niveles, auto-reparación, RAG con pgvector, y observabilidad persistente.
description_en: Multi-agent orchestration platform with 22 agents, 6 swarm topologies, 3-tier memory, self-healing, RAG with pgvector, and persistent observability.

name: MindScrolling
description_es: App móvil anti doom-scrolling con recomendación adaptativa usando pgvector (similitud coseno + EMA). Publicada en Google Play con 13K+ citas y scoring conductual.
description_en: Anti doom-scrolling mobile app with adaptive recommendation using pgvector (cosine similarity + EMA). Published on Google Play with 13K+ quotes and behavioral scoring.

name: FinanceAI Dashboard
description_es: Plataforma de analítica financiera con detección de anomalías (z-score), forecasting con regresión lineal, y chatbot IA con 5 tools de Claude.
description_en: Financial analytics platform with anomaly detection (z-score), forecasting with linear regression, and AI chatbot with 5 Claude tools.

name: HRScout LLM
description_es: Screening de candidatos con pipeline de 4 agentes IA, Claude Tool Use con 5 herramientas, scoring 0-100 y radar chart.
description_en: Candidate screening with 4-agent pipeline, Claude Tool Use with 5 tools, 0-100 scoring and radar chart.

name: Ad Analytics Pipeline
description_es: Pipeline ETL unificado para Meta Ads + Google Ads + GA4 con OCR de facturas, detección de anomalías y dashboard de analytics.
description_en: Unified ETL pipeline for Meta Ads + Google Ads + GA4 with invoice OCR, anomaly detection, and analytics dashboard.

name: Playwright Automation
description_es: Suite de automatización con 3 scrapers reales, scheduler SQLite, CLI y tests E2E. Zero mocks — todos los scrapers ejecutan contra sitios reales.
description_en: Automation suite with 3 real scrapers, SQLite scheduler, CLI, and E2E tests. Zero mocks — all scrapers run against real websites.

name: AI Document Pipeline
description_es: Pipeline de inteligencia documental con 4 agentes CrewAI y 2 servidores MCP (Filesystem + SQLite).
description_en: Document intelligence pipeline with 4 CrewAI agents and 2 MCP servers (Filesystem + SQLite).
